cues.zh: 我今天大致要聊的是，解决气候危机
cues.en: What I'm going to talk about today is just in general terms. What is needed to address the

cues.zh: 到底需要做些什么，如果我们要做，
cues.en: climate crisis, this is the thing that

cues.zh: 采取哪些行动才能加速摆脱
cues.en: if we do, what actions can we take that will accelerate the transition out of

cues.zh: 化石燃料时代。
cues.en: the Fossil fuel era

cues.zh: 自然环境中本来就有一定量的碳在循环，
cues.en: there's a certain amount of carbon that is circulating through the environment

cues.zh: 它们进入空气，被动植物吸收，
cues.en: So it's going into the air being absorbed by plants and animals

cues.zh: 然后再回到空气中，这些碳就这样在地表循环往复。
cues.en: And then getting back into the air, and this this carbon is just circulating on the surface

cues.zh: 这本来没什么问题，数亿年来一直都是这样。
cues.en: And this is fine, and it's been doing that for hundreds of millions of years

cues.zh: 但改变的是，我们往里面加了点新东西，
cues.en: The thing that's changed is that we've added something to the mix

cues.zh: 可以说是大煞风景，坏了一锅好汤。
cues.en: So this is what I would call the turd in the punchbowl

cues.zh: 我们把大量额外的碳排放
cues.en: so we added all this extra carbon

cues.zh: 加进了这个碳循环，最终结果就是，
cues.en: to the carbon cycle and the net result is that

cues.zh: 海洋和大自然中的碳与日俱增，已经远远超出了生态系统的吸收能力。
cues.en: The carbon in the oceans and atmosphere is growing over time. It's much more than can be absorbed by the ecosystem

cues.zh: 道理其实很简单：我们把深埋了数亿年的
cues.en: It's really quite simple. We're taking

cues.zh: 数十亿吨碳——
cues.en: billions of tons of carbon that's been buried for hundreds of millions of years

cues.zh: 那些原本不在碳循环中的碳，从地底深处挖出来，加进了地表的碳循环里。
cues.en: and is not part of the carbon cycle, taking it from deep underground and adding it to the carbon cycle

cues.zh: 结果就是大气和海洋中的碳含量持续上升，
cues.en: The result is a steady increase in the carbon in the atmosphere and in the oceans

cues.zh: 单看这张图表，可能感觉变化没那么大，
cues.en: which doesn't look like much if you look at it on this chart

cues.zh: 但要是放进人类历史的长河来看，其实是这副景象。
cues.en: But when looked at in the context of history it actually looks like this

cues.zh: 大约一千万年以来，碳浓度的百万分比一直在 300 左右徘徊
cues.en: The carbon parts per million has really been bouncing around the 300 level for around 10 million years

cues.zh: 而就在过去的几百年里，它几乎垂直飙升
cues.en: And in the last few hundred years it went into a vertical climb

cues.zh: 这就是问题的本质，这种情况极不寻常
cues.en: This is the the essence of the problem. This is very unusual and

cues.zh: 而且从这种增长速度就能看出，它构成了极其严峻的威胁，随之而来的
cues.en: a very extreme threat as you can see from from this rate of growth. Then this is accompanied by

cues.zh: 自然也就是气温的上升
cues.en: a temperature increase as one would expect

cues.zh: 说到气温上升……大家常聊到两度或三度
cues.en: This temperature increase... people talk about two degrees or three degrees

cues.zh: 但我们必须意识到，气候本身实际上
cues.en: It's important to appreciate just how sensitive the climate actually is

cues.zh: 对温度有多么敏感
cues.en: to temperature

cues.zh: 而且我们应该从绝对温度的角度来看待这个问题
cues.en: And it's important to look at it in terms of absolute temperature,

cues.zh: 而不是相对于零度的摄氏度，我们需要看相对于绝对零度温度变化了多少，因为宇宙
cues.en: not in degrees Celsius relative to zero. We need to say what is the temperature change relative to absolute zero, that's how the universe

cues.zh: 就是这样界定温度的，物理学也是这样看待温度的，都是以绝对零度为基准
cues.en: thinks about temperature, it's how physics thinks about temperature, it's relative to absolute zero.

cues.zh: 微小的变化会带来巨大的影响
cues.en: Small changes result in huge effects

cues.zh: 降温 5 度，纽约就会被冰封；升温 5 度，纽约就会被水淹
cues.en: So New York City under ice would be minus 5 degrees, New York City under water would be plus 5 degrees

cues.zh: 但如果换算成相对于绝对零度的百分比，其实也就浮动了 2% 左右
cues.en: But looked at as a percentage relative to absolute zero, it's only a plus minus 2 percent change

cues.zh: 所以气候的敏感度极其、极其的高
cues.en: so the sensitivity of the climate is extremely, extremely high

cues.zh: 而我们把城市直接建在海岸线上，更是放大了这种敏感度。
cues.en: We've amplified this sensitivity by building our cities right on the coastline.

cues.zh: 大多数人都住在离海很近的地方，有些国家地势非常低洼，
cues.en: And most people live very close to the ocean in some countries that are their very low-lying and would be completely

cues.zh: 一旦遭遇气候危机，就会彻底被淹没。
cues.en: under water in a climate crisis.

cues.zh: 从本质上讲，我们构建的现代文明对气候变化极度敏感。
cues.en: We've essentially designed civilization to be super sensitive to climate change.

cues.zh: 关键是要认识到，我们终将告别化石能源时代。
cues.en: The important thing to appreciate is that we are going to exit the fossil fuels era.

cues.zh: 走出化石能源时代是必然的，因为到了一定阶段，我们迟早会
cues.en: It is inevitable that we will exit the fossil fuels era because at a certain point we will simply run out of

cues.zh: 无煤可挖、无碳可烧。所以问题根本不是“会不会”，而是“何时”结束这个时代。
cues.en: carbon to mine and burn. So the question is really "when" do we exit the era not not "if".

cues.zh: 目标就是尽快
cues.en: The goal is to exit the era as

cues.zh: 退出这个时代。
cues.en: quickly as possible.

cues.zh: 这意味着我们要从旧目标转向一个前工业时代的目标，也就是从
cues.en: That means we need to move from the old goal with a pre-industrial goal, which was to move from

cues.zh: 砍伐森林、
cues.en: chopping down forests and

cues.zh: 大量捕杀鲸鱼……
cues.en: killing lots of whales...

cues.zh: 旧目标是从
cues.en: The old goal was to move from

cues.zh: 砍柴、捕鲸转向化石燃料。在那个背景下，这其实是件好事。
cues.en: chopping wood and killing whales to fossil fuels. Which actually in that context was a good thing.

cues.zh: 但新目标是转向
cues.en: But the new goal is to move to

cues.zh: 可持续的能源未来。
cues.en: sustainable energy future.

cues.zh: 我们想利用
cues.en: We want to use things like

cues.zh: 水电、太阳能、风能、地热能。在法国这类不受自然灾害影响的地方，
cues.en: Hydro, Solar, Wind, Geothermal. Nuclear is also a good option in

cues.zh: 核能也是个不错的选择。
cues.en: places like France which aren't subject to natural disasters.

cues.zh: 我们要用能造福十亿年的能源。
cues.en: And we want to use energy sources that will be good for a billion years.

cues.zh: 那么，如何加速这场从化石燃料向可持续时代的转型？
cues.en: So how do we accelerate this transition away from fossil fuels to a sustainable, era?

cues.zh: 如果不转型，又会怎样？
cues.en: And what happens if we don't?

cues.zh: 所以如果我们等待，
cues.en: So if we wait,

cues.zh: 如果我们推迟改变，
cues.en: and if we delay the change,

cues.zh: 最好的情况，也不过是推迟那场不可避免的向可持续能源的转型。
cues.en: The best case is simply delaying that inevitable transition to sustainable energy.

cues.zh: 所以，如果我们现在不采取行动，这就是最好的情况。
cues.en: So this is the best case if we don't take action now.

cues.zh: 冒着重复的风险，
cues.en: At the risk of being repetitive,

cues.zh: 从长远来看，转向可持续能源是别无选择的。这是不言自明的。
cues.en: There's going to be no choice in the long term to move to sustainable energy. It's tautological.

cues.zh: 我们必须拥有可持续能源，否则我们就会耗尽另一种能源。
cues.en: We have to have sustainable energy or we'll simply run out of the other one.

cues.zh: 所以，放缓转型我们唯一得到的……
cues.en: So the only thing we gain by slowing down the transition is...

cues.zh: 就是把它放缓了而已。它并不会让转型不发生。只是放缓了它。
cues.en: It is just slowing it down. It doesn't make it not occur. Just slows it down.

cues.zh: 然而，最坏的情况，
cues.en: The worst case however,

cues.zh: 是比历史上所有战争加起来还要多的流离失所和破坏
cues.en: is more displacement and destruction than all the wars in history combined

cues.zh: 这些就是最好/最坏的情况。
cues.en: These are the best/worst-case scenarios.

cues.zh: 大约有3%的科学家相信最好的情况。
cues.en: We have about 3% of scientists that believe in the best case.

cues.zh: 还有大约 97% 的人相信最坏的情况会发生。
cues.en: And about 97% that believe in the worst case.

cues.zh: 这就是为什么我称它为史上最愚蠢的实验。你为什么要这么做？
cues.en: This is why I call it the dumbest experiment in history - ever. Why would you do this?

cues.zh: 所以，之所以
cues.en: So the reason that

cues.zh: 转型被推迟，或者进展缓慢，是因为所有产生碳排放的活动都享受着隐性补贴。
cues.en: the transition is delayed, or is happening slowly, is because there is a hidden subsidy on all carbon producing activity.

cues.zh: 在一个健康的市场里，
cues.en: In a healthy market,

cues.zh: 如果你获得 10 欧元的收益，却给社会造成 4 欧元的损害，那么利润就是 6 欧元。
cues.en: if you have 10€ benefit and 4€ of harm to society, the profit would be 6€.

cues.zh: 这显然合情合理。此时，激励机制与美好的未来相一致。
cues.en: It makes obvious sense. This is where the incentives are aligned with a good future.

cues.zh: 但如今并非如此。
cues.en: This is not this is not the case today.

cues.zh: 如果激励机制方向一致，那么推动我们迈向
cues.en: but if you have the incentives aligned, then the forcing function towards a

cues.zh: 美好未来、可持续能源未来的力量就会很强大。
cues.en: good future, a sustainable energy future, will be powerful.

cues.zh: 在一个不健康的市场里，
cues.en: In an unhealthy market you have

cues.zh: 你获得 10 欧元的收益，但那 4 欧元的损害没有被征税，因此就产生了未征税的负外部性。
cues.en: 10€ of benefit, but the 4€ of harm isn't taxed so you have an untaxed negative externality.

cues.zh: 这是最基础的经济学原理。
cues.en: This is basic economics 101.

cues.zh: 这样一来，就会有不合理的利润，还会形成一种强制机制，
cues.en: So you have unreasonable profit and a forcing function

cues.zh: 让人们从事排放碳的活动，因为他们没有为此付出给社会带来的代价。
cues.en: to do carbon-emitting activity because this cost to society is not being paid.

cues.zh: 最终，每年有 350 亿吨碳排放到大气中。
cues.en: The net result is 35 gigatons of carbon per year into the atmosphere.

cues.zh: 这就好比
cues.en: This is analogous to

cues.zh: 不为垃圾处理付费。
cues.en: not paying for garbage collection.

cues.zh: 我们不会在垃圾问题上说：
cues.en: It's not as though we should say, in the case of garbage,

cues.zh: 要建立一个没有垃圾的社会。要做到这一点非常难，但重要的是，人们要为垃圾处理付费。
cues.en: Have a garbage-free society. It's very difficult to have a garbage-free society, but it's just important that people pay for the garbage collection.

cues.zh: 所以我们需要……
cues.en: so we need to...

cues.zh: 摆脱未征税的负外部性，也就是一种隐性碳补贴，
cues.en: Go from having untaxed negative externality, which is effectively a hidden carbon subsidy

cues.zh: 而且规模巨大，
cues.en: of enormous size,

cues.zh: 国际货币基金组织估算，每年高达 5.3 万亿美元。
cues.en: 5.3 Trillion dollars a year according to the IMF every year.

cues.zh: 我们需要摆脱这种状况，
cues.en: We need to move away from this,

cues.zh: 改为征收碳税。
cues.en: and have a carbon tax.

cues.zh: 这件事正遭到
cues.en: This is being this is being fought quite hard by

cues.zh: 碳生产商的强烈抵制，他们用的手段和
cues.en: The carbon producers, and they're using tactics that are very similar to what the

cues.zh: 烟草行业用了很多年的手法非常相似。
cues.en: the Tobacco industry used for many years.

cues.zh: 他们会采取这样的做法……尽管压倒性的科学共识是
cues.en: They would take the approach of... even though the overwhelming scientific consensus was that

cues.zh: 吸烟有害健康，他们会找几个不同意的科学家，然后说“看，科学家们有分歧。”
cues.en: smoking cigarettes was bad for you, they would find a few scientists that would disagree and then they would say "look, scientists disagree."

cues.zh: 所以他们基本上就是用这种方式试图欺骗公众
cues.en: So that's essentially how they would try to trick the public

cues.zh: 让人们以为吸烟没那么糟。
cues.en: into thinking that smoking is not that bad.

cues.zh: 解决办法显然就是取消补贴。
cues.en: The solution obviously is to remove the subsidy.

cues.zh: 这意味着我们需要征收碳税。
cues.en: That means we need to have a carbon tax.

cues.zh: 而且要让它既不是左派也不是右派的议题。我们应该把它做成大概是收入中性的碳税
cues.en: And to make it something which is neither a left nor right issue. We should make it probably a revenue-neutral carbon tax

cues.zh: 所以这就是一种情况：提高对碳的征税，但在其他地方减税。
cues.en: So this would be a case of increasing taxes on carbon, but then reducing taxes in other places.

cues.zh: 所以或许可以降低销售税或增值税，同时提高碳税。
cues.en: So maybe there would be a reduction in sales tax or VAT and an increase in carbon tax.

cues.zh: 只有那些大量使用碳的人，才会缴纳更高的税。
cues.en: Only those using high levels of carbon would pay an increased tax.

cues.zh: 此外，为了给
cues.en: Moreover, in order to give

cues.zh: 行业留出反应时间，这可以采取分阶段推进的方式。
cues.en: the industry time to react, this could be a phased-in approach.

cues.zh: 也就是说，也许要过5年
cues.en: So that maybe it takes 5 years before

cues.zh: 碳税才会变得很高，这样只有那些今天不采取行动的公司，才会在五年后受损。
cues.en: the carbon taxes are very high, so that only companies that don't take action today will suffer in five years.

cues.zh: 但政府在这方面需要发出明确的信号。
cues.en: But there needs to be a clear message from government in this regard.

cues.zh: 因为根本问题在于，今天的规则
cues.en: because the fundamental problem is the rules today

cues.zh: 在激励人们制造碳排放，这简直是疯了！你激励什么，什么就会发生。
cues.en: incent people to create carbon, and this is madness! Whatever you incent will happen.

cues.zh: 这就是为什么
cues.en: That's why

cues.zh: 到目前为止我们看到的效果非常小。
cues.en: we're seeing very little effect thus far.

cues.zh: 而我们采取什么行动
cues.en: And depending upon what action we take

cues.zh: 将决定碳排放数字走向
cues.en: will drive the the carbon number to

cues.zh: 极端还是温和的水平。
cues.en: either extreme or moderate levels.

cues.zh: 我认为两度的升温基本已成定局
cues.en: I think it's pretty much a given that that the two-degree

cues.zh: 问题在于升幅会不会远超这个数字……
cues.en: increase will occur... the question is whether it's going to be much more than that...

cues.zh: 而不是会不会升两度。
cues.en: not if there will be a 2 degree increase.

cues.zh: 那么问题就变成了：你能做些什么？
cues.en: So then the question is what can you do?

cues.zh: 我的建议是，只要有机会
cues.en: I would say whenever you have the opportunity

cues.zh: 就去和政客谈，要求他们征收碳税。我们必须纠正这个未被定价的外部性。
cues.en: talk to your politicians, ask them to enact a carbon tax. We have to fix the unpriced externality.

cues.zh: 和你的朋友们聊聊这件事
cues.en: Talk to your friends about it and

cues.zh: 并抵制碳产业散布的宣传。
cues.en: fight the propaganda from the carbon industry.

cues.zh: 这就是我要传达的基本信息，我很乐意回答提问。
cues.en: So that's the basic message I have and I'm happy to take questions.
